derivation:
by
  apply Real.log_pos
  simp [Nat.one_lt_iff_ne_zero_and_ne_one, Ideal.absNorm_eq_zero_iff, p.ne_bot, Ideal.IsPrime.ne_top p.isPrime]
explanation: Specialize Real.log_pos to the real-valued absolute norm. Its hypothesis simplifies using that p is a nonzero proper prime ideal. The current proof explicitly applies this declaration.
